messages:
Iris (CS): quick post-cutover sync for Mistral private/VPC. main open: SOC wants 270d retention, KMS cross-account grant pattern, and intermittent 403s on high-volume put requests. can we triage owners and ETA?
Owen (Mistral PM): SOC will fail without 270 days. bucket name: mistral-priv-logs, key alias/msc-key. 403s spike at 16:20 UTC during a 5k/sec burst.
Sam (Solutions): likely client-side concurrency + KMS encryption contention. can you confirm collector concurrency and whether server-side encryption uses KMS encryption context?
Owen (Mistral PM): collector concurrency 24, SSE-KMS with EncryptionContext {"deployment":"mistral"}.
Rina (Security Eng): KMS approach: recommend Nebula-style role in customer account (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/mistral-priv-ingest) with a key policy entry granting kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey scoped to that role and aws:SourceAccount. rotation cadence OK at 365d; note in runbook.
Sam (Solutions): immediate mitigation: reduce max concurrency to 8 and enable jittered exponential backoff. I'll push a collector change to staging and run a 20m soak.
Iris (CS): actions: Sam - collector change + soak (due: next business day AM). Rina - key policy snippet + small audit paragraph (due: Wed EOD). Owen - apply S3 lifecycle (retain 270d, transition to GLACIER after 60d) or tell us if infra needs help (due: Wed afternoon). I'll track.
collector-bot: Deploy queued: collector-concurrency-update (run id: q-7784).
Sam (Solutions): queued change applied to staging, soak in progress. initial 10m: 403s dropped from intermittent to zero. posting full soak in 20m.
Rina (Security Eng): audit paragraph: "Mistral private deployment forwards VPC and application logs to the customer-managed S3 bucket 'mistral-priv-logs' with retention set to 270 days and lifecycle transition to Glacier after 60 days. Cryptographic protection uses a customer-managed AWS KMS key (alias/msc-key); Redwood assumes a least-privileged, dedicated cross-account ingest role for decryption during ingestion. Key rotation is enabled annually and emergency rekey/rollback procedures are documented in the private deploy runbook."
Owen (Mistral PM): thanks. infra will apply lifecycle change this afternoon and confirm.
Sam (Solutions): soak complete: 20m with zero 403s, average put latency 140ms. rolling change to prod now.
Iris (CS): marking account health 'green with notes' pending lifecycle confirmation. follow-up call scheduled Thu 11am. if anything blocks sooner, ping this thread.
